hook: Ben tells Anna about his plan for the weekend.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I am going to take a bus trip to the mountains.

translation.vi: Mình sẽ đi xe buýt đến vùng núi.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Yes, I am going to rest on the trip.

translation.vi: Ừ, mình sẽ nghỉ ngơi trong chuyến đi.

gloss.en: a time when you go to another place and come back
a big car that many people use to travel

grammar_notes: Use 'am/is/are going to' + verb to talk about plans for the future, like 'I am going to take a bus trip.'
interaction_prompts: Where are you going to go this weekend?
